leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom component using forwardRef to pass a ref through to a child DOM element.
Construct a parent component that creates a ref and attaches it to a forwardRef child component.
Manipulate a child DOM node directly from a parent component by using the exposed ref.
Configure a forwardRef component to conditionally expose a DOM node or a custom imperative handle.
Integrate forwardRef with event handlers to control child DOM behavior from a parent component.
Apply forwardRef in a practical scenario to focus an input field from a parent button click.
